scripts.dev: sh -c 'set -a; . ./.env.observe; set +a; bash ./scripts/observe/dev-local-up.sh; DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_PORT=5432 DB_NAME=${OBSERVE_DB_NAME:-observedb} DB_USER=${OBSERVE_DB_USER:-observe} DB_PASSWORD=${OBSERVE_DB_PASSWORD} REDIS_URL=redis://:${OBSERVE_REDIS_PASSWORD:-}@127.0.0.1:6379 JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE=../secrets/jwt_api_private.pem JWT_KEY_ID=api JWT_SIGNING_SERVICE=api JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_FILES=agent=../secrets/jwt_agent_public.pem,automation=../secrets/jwt_automation_public.pem PORT=3009 VITE_DEV_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:5177 npm --prefix ./r-observe run dev'
scripts.observe:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.observe.yml --env-file .env.observe --profile observe-core --profile observe-ai --profile observe-monitoring --profile r-observe-proxy up -d
scripts.observe:up:full: docker compose -f docker-compose.observe.yml --env-file .env.observe --profile observe-core --profile observe-ai --profile observe-agent --profile observe-monitoring --profile observe-icinga --profile r-observe-proxy up -d
scripts.observe:release-check: npm run observe:validate && npm run observe:security
scripts.observe:test: npm --prefix ./packages/auth test && npm --prefix ./r-observe/api test && npm --prefix ./r-observe/worker test && npm --prefix ./r-observe/discovery test && npm --prefix ./r-observe/ai test && npm --prefix ./r-observe/agent test
scripts.release:validate:enterprise: node ./scripts/release/validate-enterprise-package.js --zip dist/r-observe.zip --runtime && node ./scripts/release/validate-enterprise-package.js --zip dist/r-observe-release.zip --runtime && bash ./scripts/package/validate-extracted-runtime.sh dist/r-observe.zip && bash ./scripts/package/validate-extracted-runtime.sh dist/r-observe-release.zip
scripts.zip:deploy: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/r-observe-deploy.zip && git ls-files -z -- . ':(exclude)docs/**' ':(exclude)tests/**' ':(exclude)test-results/**' ':(exclude).agents/**' ':(exclude).claude/**' ':(exclude).codex/**' ':(exclude)dist/**' | tr "\\0" '\n' | zip -q -9 dist/r-observe-deploy.zip -@
